question: Which constructors had the top 3 combined points from their best driver and team, and in which years did they achieve them?
sql:
WITH constructor_year_max AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.constructor_id,
        c.name as constructor_name,
        r.year,
        MAX(rs.points) as max_constructor_points
    FROM constructor_standings rs
    JOIN constructors c ON rs.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
    JOIN races r ON rs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY rs.constructor_id, c.name, r.year
),
driver_year_max AS (
    SELECT 
        rd.constructor_id,
        r.year,
        MAX(rd.points) as max_driver_points
    FROM results rd
    JOIN races r ON rd.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY rd.constructor_id, r.year
)
SELECT 
    coy.constructor_name,
    coy.year,
    coy.max_constructor_points,
    doy.max_driver_points,
    coy.max_constructor_points + doy.max_driver_points as combined_points
FROM constructor_year_max coy
JOIN driver_year_max doy ON coy.constructor_id = doy.constructor_id AND coy.year = doy.year
ORDER BY combined_points DESC
LIMIT 3
